title: My School Day
text:
Maria goes to school every day. Her favorite subject is science. In science class, she learns about plants and animals. She likes to do experiments with water and light.

Today is Monday. Maria has math first, and then she has English. Math is hard for her, but she is happy. She studies with her friend Tom.

questions.text: What subject does Maria have first on Monday?
How does Maria probably feel about science class?
Why does Maria probably study with Tom?

vocabulary.definition: the study of nature and how things work
tests you do to find out what happens
a person you know well and like

paragraph_translations: María va a la escuela todos los días. Su materia favorita es la ciencia. En la clase de ciencias aprende sobre las plantas y los animales. Le gusta hacer experimentos con agua y luz.
Hoy es lunes. María tiene matemáticas primero y luego tiene inglés. Las matemáticas son difíciles para ella, pero está contenta. Estudia con su amigo Tom.
